    Private Sub AddLabels()
        If d.Columns.Count = 0 Then
            GoTo label_0
        End If
        Me.AutoScroll = True
        tempLabel = New Label(d.Columns.Count) {}
        tempcmb = New ComboBox(d.Columns.Count) {}
        tempTable = New DataTable(d.Columns.Count) {}
        CNT = 0
        Dim X As Integer = 1
        Dim X1 As Integer = 105
        Dim Y As Integer = 10
        While CNT < d.Columns.Count
            If Y > GrpDtls.Height - 20 Then
                Y = 10
                X = X + 200
                X1 = X1 + 200
            End If
            tempTable(CNT) = New DataTable
            tempTable(CNT) = dsfrm1.Tables(0).Copy
            tempLabel(CNT) = New Label
            tempLabel(CNT).Location = New System.Drawing.Point(X, Y)
            tempLabel(CNT).Size = New System.Drawing.Size(100, 20)
            tempLabel(CNT).TextAlign = ContentAlignment.TopRight
            tempLabel(CNT).ForeColor = System.Drawing.Color.Black
            tempLabel(CNT).Text = d.Columns(CNT).ToString
            tempLabel(CNT).Name = "lbl" + d.Columns(CNT).ToString
            GrpDtls.Controls.Add(tempLabel(CNT))
            tempLabel(CNT).Visible = True
            tempcmb(CNT) = New ComboBox
            tempcmb(CNT).Location = New System.Drawing.Point(X1, Y)
            tempcmb(CNT).Size = New System.Drawing.Size(100, 20)
            tempcmb(CNT).ForeColor = System.Drawing.Color.Black
            tempcmb(CNT).DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList
            tempcmb(CNT).TabIndex = CNT + 8
            tempcmb(CNT).Name = "tempcmb" + d.Columns(CNT).ToString
            tempcmb(CNT).DataSource = tempTable(CNT)
            tempcmb(CNT).DisplayMember = "Field"
            GrpDtls.Controls.Add(tempcmb(CNT))
            AddHandler tempcmb(CNT).SelectedIndexChanged, AddressOf SelectedIndexChanged
            tempLabel(CNT).Visible = True
            CNT += 1
            Y = Y + 35
        End While
        '  Try
        SetGrpDtlsData()
        'Catch ex As Exception

        'End Try
label_0:
    End Sub

                'End If
            Else
                'MessageBox.Show("Excel is not in correct format")
            End If
            CNT = CNT + 1
        End While
    End Sub

            CmbBankAcc.SelectedIndex = 0

    End Sub

    Private Function checkdata() As Boolean
        Dim flag2 As Boolean = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode")).ToString.Trim, "", False) = 0
        If flag2 Then
            Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
            VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode"))
            VsfgProduct.Focus()
            Return False
        Else
            flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
            If flag2 Then
                Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("ProdName"))
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                Return False
            Else
                flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CatCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                If flag2 Then
                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                    VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                    Return False
                Else
                    flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BrCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                    If flag2 Then
                        Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                        VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                        VsfgProduct.Focus()
                        Return False
                    Else
                        flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                        If flag2 Then
                            Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                            VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                            VsfgProduct.Focus()
                            Return False
                            flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubCatCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                        Else
                            If flag2 Then
                                Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                Return False
                            Else
                                flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GrpCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                                If flag2 Then
                                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                    VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                    Return False
                                Else
                                    flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubGrpCode")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                                    If flag2 Then
                                        Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                        VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                                        VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                        Return False

                                    Else
                                        flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer")).ToString.Trim(), "", False) = 0
                                        If flag2 Then
                                            Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                            VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer"))
                                            VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                            Return False
                                        Else

                                            flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")).ToString.Trim) <= 0.0R
                                            If flag2 Then
                                                Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Box Pack zero not allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                                VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Boxpack"))
                                                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                                Return False
                                            Else
                                                flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")).ToString.Trim) <= 0.0R
                                                If flag2 Then
                                                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Inner Box Pack zero not allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                                    VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack"))
                                                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                                    Return False
                                                Else
                                                    flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")).ToString.Trim) > Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")).ToString.Trim)
                                                    If flag2 Then
                                                        Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Inner Box Packing should not be greater than Box Packing.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                                        VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack"))
                                                        VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                                        Return False
                                                    Else
                                                        flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")).ToString.Trim) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")).ToString.Trim)) <> (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")).ToString.Trim) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")).ToString.Trim))
                                                        If flag2 Then
                                                            Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Specify InBox-Box Packing Wrong.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                                                            VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack"))
                                                            VsfgProduct.Focus()
                                                            Return False
                                                        Else
                                                            Return True
                                                        End If
                                                    End If
                                                End If
                                            End If
                                        End If
                                    End If
                                End If
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End Function


    Private Function checkdata1() As Boolean
        Dim flag2 As Boolean = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("AcCode")).ToString, "", False) = 0
        If flag2 Then
            Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
            VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("AcCode"))
            VsfgProduct.Focus()
            Return False
        Else
            flag2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(VsfgProduct(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("AcName")).ToString, "", False) = 0
            If flag2 Then
                Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Blank Entry Can't be Allowed.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                VsfgProduct.Select(j, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("AcName"))
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                Return False
            Else
                Return True
            End If
        End If
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Sub BtnSave_Click(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles BtnSave.Click

        'Reset only the dedicated IMEI Purchase import summary.
        PurchaseIMEIReport.Length = 0
        PurchaseIMEIReportPath = ""
        PurchaseIMEISavedCount = 0
        PurchaseIMEIDuplicateCount = 0
        PurchaseIMEIFailedCount = 0
        PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = ""
        PurchaseIMEILastGroupError = ""

        If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 17 Then

    Private Sub CalNetAmt()
        Dim TmpAddVal, TmpLessVal As Double
        TmpAddVal = 0.0R
        TmpAddVal = 0.0R
        TmpRetNetAmt = 0.0R
        TmpRetRndAmt = 0.0R
        Dim TmpCalcRounding As String = "Y"
        TmpSurchargeAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpVatAmt) * Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.SurchargePer / 100.0R, "Fixed")

        TmpSurchargeAmt = TmpSurchargeAmt + TmpCess1 + TmpCess2
        TmpRetNetAmt = 0
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt))) >= 0.5R
        If flag1 Then
            TmpRetRndAmt = 1.0R - Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt)), "Fixed"))
            TmpRetNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetRndAmt), "Fixed"))
        Else
            flag1 = (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt))) < 0.5R
            If flag1 Then
                TmpRetRndAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt))
                TmpRetNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetRndAmt), "Fixed"))
                TmpRetRndAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(0.0R - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetRndAmt), "Fixed"))
            End If
        End If
        TmpAddVal = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpGrossAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpVatAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(0) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpSurchargeAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpAddLessAmt) ' + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpCess1) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpCess2)
        TmpLessVal = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpTprAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpSchAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpBtmAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpStarAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpCdAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(0) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRetNetAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpDisplayAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpCoupanAmt)
        TmpNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpAddVal) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpLessVal))
        TmpNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpTCSAmt))
        If TmpCalcRounding = "Y" Then
            flag1 = (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt))) >= 0.5R
            If flag1 Then
                TmpRndAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(1.0R - Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt)), "Fixed")))
                TmpNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRndAmt), "Fixed")
            Else
                flag1 = (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt))) < 0.5R
                If flag1 Then
                    TmpRndAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Int(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt)))
                    TmpNetAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpNetAmt) - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRndAmt), "Fixed")
                    TmpRndAmt = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(0.0R - Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpRndAmt), "Fixed")
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub SaveExcelData()
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Conn = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.OpenYearConn()
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd = New SqlClient.SqlCommand("Save_ImportExcelData", Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Conn)
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@SysCompCode", SqlDbType.Int).Value = CmbComp.SelectedValue
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@StrField", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = StrField
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@strSelectedIndex", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = StrSelectedIndex
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@Entry", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = CmbEntry.SelectedIndex
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@TMPROWCOUNT", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TmpCount
        'Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.Parameters.Add("@TMPColCOUNT", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TmpColCount
        Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
        Ultimate.Mod_Connection.CloseYearConn(Ultimate.Mod_DataBase.Conn)
    End Sub

                    s = "Select p.SysProdCode,p.ProdCode,p.ProdName,p.BasicUnit,p.BoxPack,p.InBoxPack,p.BoxName,p.InBoxName,p.RatePerUnit,v.VatType,v.VatPer "

                    s = s + " ,p.Weight,p.SysCompCode"
                    s = s + " from Mas_Product p,Mas_Vat v,Mas_Account a,Mas_Account a1,Mas_Account a2"
                    s = s + " where p.SysVatCode=v.SysVatCode and v.SalCode=a.AcCode and v.VatSCode=a1.AcCode and v.SrCode=a2.AcCode"

                        s = s + " and p.ProdCode='" + Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(SchOnFreeProdCode) + "'"
                    End If

                    Dim ds1 As New System.Data.DataSet
                    ds1.Tables.Clear()
                    ds1 = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(s)
                    If ds1.Tables(0).Rows.Count = 0 Then
                        If Not NotProductName.Contains(SchOnFreeProdCode) Then
                            NotProductName = NotProductName + Environment.NewLine + "Code " + SchOnFreeProdCode
                            'NotProductCode = NotProductCode + Environment.NewLine + VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode")).ToString

                            'NotProductMRP = NotProductMRP + Environment.NewLine + VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("MRP")).ToString
                        End If
                        'VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeOnfreeSysProdCode")) = VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeOnfreeSysProdCode")).ToString() + " " + "0"
                    Else
                        If VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeOnfreeSysProdCode")).ToString().Length > 0 Then
                            VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeOnfreeSysProdCode")) = VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeOnfreeSysProdCode")).ToString() + " " + ds1.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString()

                        End If
                    End If
                    If SFrProdCode.Contains(" ") Then
                        SFrProdCode = SFrProdCode.Remove(0, SchOnFreeProdCode.Length + 1)
                    Else
                        SFrProdCode = SFrProdCode.Remove(0, SchOnFreeProdCode.Length)
                    End If
                End While
                j = j + 1
            End While
        End If

    Private Sub SetupPara()
        paravalue("CASH DISCOUNT")
        ChngCd = ComboBox1.Text
        Dim tax As String = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='TAX APPLY IN SALE'"
        dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(tax)
        TmpTaxApply = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)

        'Dim s6 As String = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='VAT CALCULATION'"
        'dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
        'dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(s6)
        'VatCalcOn = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)


        'New Change(Company wise Vat)
        Dim s6 As String = ""
        If CmbComp.Text = "All" Then
            s6 = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='VAT CALCULATION'"
            dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
            dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(s6)
            VatCalcOn = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            's6 = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='VAT CALCULATION'"
            s6 = "Select VatOn"
            s6 = s6 + " from T_CompanyVat v,Mas_Company c"
            s6 = s6 + " Where v.SysCompCode=c.SysCompCode and c.SysCompCode='" + CmbComp.SelectedValue.ToString + "' "
            If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 0 Then
                s6 = s6 + " and Type='SAL'"
                'ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 Then
                '    s6 = s6 + " and Type='PUR'"
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 2 Then
                s6 = s6 + " and Type='CRN'"
                'ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 3 Then
                '    s6 = s6 + " and Type='DRN'"
            Else
                GoTo l1
            End If

            dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
            dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(s6)
            If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
                If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "" Then
                    GoTo l1
                Else

                    If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Gross Amount" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 0
                    ElseIf dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Gross-Scheme" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 1
                    ElseIf dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Gross-Scheme-Star" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 2
                    ElseIf dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Gross-Scheme-Cash" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 3
                    ElseIf dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Gross-Cash" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 4
                    ElseIf dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString = "Net Amount" Then
                        VatCalcOn = 5
                    End If
                End If
            Else
l1:
                s6 = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='VAT CALCULATION'"
                dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
                dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(s6)
                VatCalcOn = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)
            End If
        End If


        SqlStr = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='Import Negative'"
        dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
        TmpNegativeStock = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)

        Try
            SqlStr = "select paravalue from SetupParameters where ParaName='DEDUCT PRIMARY DISCAMT'"
            dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
            dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
            TmpPriDiscAmt = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)

        Catch ex As Exception
        End Try

        SqlStr = " SELECT ParaValue FROM SetUpParameters WHERE ParaName='Auto Invoice Numbers'"
        dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
        If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
            TmpAutoVoucher = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)
        Else
            TmpAutoVoucher = ""
        End If



        SqlStr = " SELECT ParaValue FROM SetUpParameters WHERE ParaName='DEDUCT DISCAMT FROM ALLTRAN'"
        dsfrm.Tables.Clear()
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
        If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
            TmpAllTran = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0)

        Else
            TmpAllTran = "N"
        End If
        TmpAllTranDisc = TmpAllTran


        SqlStr = "Select ParaValue From SetupParameters Where ParaName='ALLOW CESS IN SALES'"
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
        If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
            TmpAllowSalCess = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString
        End If

        SqlStr = "Select ParaValue From SetupParameters Where ParaName='ALLOW CESS IN PURCHASE'"
        dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
        If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
            TmpAllowPurCess = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString
        End If


    End Sub

    Private Sub AddSeries()
        If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex <> 10 Or CmbEntry.SelectedIndex <> 19 Then
            j = 1
            While j < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
                Dim s As String = VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo"))
                If VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")).ToString.Contains(" ") And VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                    Dim s1 As String = s.Substring(0, s.IndexOf(" "))
                    Dim s2 As String = s.Substring(s.IndexOf(" "))
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")) = s1
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) = s2
                ElseIf VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                    'VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")) = s.Substring(0, GetPositionOfFirstNumericCharacter(s) - 1)
                    'VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) = s.Substring(GetPositionOfFirstNumericCharacter(s) - 1)
                    If CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) > 0 Then
                        VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")) = s.Substring(0, CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
                        VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) = s.Substring(CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
                    Else
                        VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")) = ""
                    End If

                End If
                j = j + 1
            End While
        Else
            j = 1
            While j < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
                Dim s As String = VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo"))
                If VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")).ToString.Contains(" ") And VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                    Dim s1 As String = s.Substring(0, s.IndexOf(" "))
                    Dim s2 As String = s.Substring(s.IndexOf(" "))
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s1
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s2
                ElseIf VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                    'VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s.Substring(0, GetPositionOfFirstNumericCharacter(s) - 1)
                    'VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s.Substring(GetPositionOfFirstNumericCharacter(s) - 1)
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s.Substring(0, CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
                    VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s.Substring(CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
                End If
                j = j + 1
            End While
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub AddBillSeries()
        j = 1
        While j < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
            Dim s As String = VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo"))
            If VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")).ToString.Contains(" ") And VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                Dim s1 As String = s.Substring(0, s.IndexOf(" "))
                Dim s2 As String = s.Substring(s.IndexOf(" "))
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s1
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s2
            ElseIf CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) = 0 And VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s.Substring(0, CheckForAlphaCharacters(s))
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s.Substring(CheckForAlphaCharacters(s))
            ElseIf VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")).ToString = "" Then
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillSeries")) = s.Substring(0, CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
                VsfgSelect(j, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BillNo")) = s.Substring(CheckForAlphaCharacters(s) + 1)
            End If
            j = j + 1
        End While
    End Sub

    Function CheckForAlphaCharacters(ByVal StringToCheck As String)
        Dim m As Integer = 0
        For i = 0 To StringToCheck.Length - 1
            If Char.IsLetter(StringToCheck.Chars(i)) Then
                m = i
            End If
        Next
        Return m
    End Function

    'IMEI purchases only. Keep the original SQL company/series/number identity.
    Private Function PurchaseIMEINumber(ByVal Value As Object) As Integer
        Dim Number As Decimal
        If Not Decimal.TryParse(Convert.ToString(Value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Trim(),
                                System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign Or System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint,
                                System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, Number) OrElse
           Number <= 0D OrElse Number > Integer.MaxValue OrElse Decimal.Truncate(Number) <> Number Then
            Throw New InvalidOperationException("Invalid GRN number: " + Convert.ToString(Value))
        End If
        Return Decimal.ToInt32(Number)
    End Function

    Private Function PurchaseIMEICell(ByVal Row As Integer, ByVal Column As String) As String
        Dim ColumnIndex As Integer = VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf(Column)
        If ColumnIndex < 0 Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Missing purchase column: " + Column)
        Return Convert.ToString(VsfgSelect(Row, ColumnIndex)).Trim()
    End Function

    Private Function PurchaseIMEIKey(ByVal Row As Integer) As String
        Dim Series As String = PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "TrnSeries")
        Return Series.Length.ToString() + ":" + Series + ":" +
            PurchaseIMEINumber(PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "TrnNo")).ToString() + ":" +
            Integer.Parse(PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "SysCompCodeALL")).ToString()
    End Function

    Private Sub PreparePurchaseIMEIRows()
        'A separate index provides numeric ordering without changing source column types.
        Dim Index As New DataTable()
        Index.Columns.Add("Series", GetType(String))
        Index.Columns.Add("Number", GetType(Integer))
        Index.Columns.Add("Company", GetType(Integer))
        Index.Columns.Add("Ordinal", GetType(Integer))
        Index.Columns.Add("SourceRow", GetType(Object))
        Dim Ordinal As Integer = 0
        For Each SourceRow As DataRow In d1.Rows
            If SourceRow.RowState = DataRowState.Deleted Then Continue For
            Dim Number As Integer = Integer.MaxValue
            Dim Company As Integer = 0
            'Invalid rows stay in the work list and receive an explicit failure result.
            Try
                Number = PurchaseIMEINumber(SourceRow("TrnNo"))
            Catch
            End Try
            Integer.TryParse(Convert.ToString(SourceRow("SysCompCodeALL")), Company)
            Index.Rows.Add(Convert.ToString(SourceRow("TrnSeries")).Trim(), Number, Company, Ordinal, SourceRow)
            Ordinal += 1
        Next
        Dim View As New DataView(Index)
        View.Sort = "Series ASC, Number ASC, Company ASC, Ordinal ASC"
        Dim Ordered As DataTable = d1.Clone()
        For Each Entry As DataRowView In View
            Ordered.ImportRow(DirectCast(Entry("SourceRow"), DataRow))
        Next
        d1 = Ordered
        VsfgSelect.DataSource = d1
    End Sub

    Private Sub ReadPurchaseIMEIHeader(ByVal Row As Integer)
        'Read to locals first. An invalid field must never leave a partly refreshed header.
        Dim Series As String = PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "TrnSeries")
        Dim Number As Integer = PurchaseIMEINumber(PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "TrnNo"))
        Dim Company As Integer = Integer.Parse(PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "SysCompCodeALL"))
        Dim Supplier As Integer = Integer.Parse(PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "SysAcCode"))
        If Supplier <= 0 Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Supplier is not mapped: " + PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "CompAcCode"))
        Dim Invoice As String = PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "InvNo")
        TmpSeries = Series
        TmpTrnNo = Number.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        TmpSysCompCode = Company
        TmpSysAcCode = Supplier
        TmpInvoiceNo = Invoice
    End Sub

    Private Function FindPurchaseIMEIHeader(ByVal Series As String, ByVal Number As Integer,
                                          ByVal Company As Integer) As DataTable
        Dim Result As New DataTable()
        Dim Connection As SqlConnection = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.OpenYearConn()
        Try
            Using Command As New SqlCommand("SELECT TrnNo, TrnSeries, SysCompCode, InvNo, SysAcCode FROM T_Pur_Header WHERE TrnNo=@Number AND ISNULL(TrnSeries,'')=@Series AND SysCompCode=@Company", Connection)
                Command.Parameters.Add("@Number", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Number
                Command.Parameters.Add("@Series", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = Series
                Command.Parameters.Add("@Company", SqlDbType.Int).Value = Company
                Using Reader As SqlDataReader = Command.ExecuteReader()
                    Result.Load(Reader)
                End Using
            End Using
        Finally
            Ultimate.Mod_Connection.CloseYearConn(Connection)
        End Try
        Return Result
    End Function

    Private Function PurchaseIMEIInvoiceMatches(ByVal Header As DataRow) As Boolean
        Return String.Equals(Convert.ToString(Header("InvNo")).Trim(), TmpInvoiceNo.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) AndAlso
            Convert.ToString(Header("SysAcCode")).Trim() = TmpSysAcCode.ToString().Trim()
    End Function

    Private Function CheckPurchaseIMEIExisting() As Boolean
        Dim Existing As DataTable = FindPurchaseIMEIHeader(TmpSeries, CInt(TmpTrnNo), TmpSysCompCode)
        If Existing.Rows.Count = 0 Then Return False
        If Existing.Rows.Count <> 1 Then
            Throw New InvalidOperationException("Multiple database headers match this company/series/GRN. Review the existing records.")
        End If
        Dim Header As DataRow = Existing.Rows(0)
        If Not PurchaseIMEIInvoiceMatches(Header) Then
            Throw New InvalidOperationException("GRN key conflict, not a duplicate invoice. Existing invoice: " +
                Convert.ToString(Header("InvNo")) + "; supplier code: " + Convert.ToString(Header("SysAcCode")) +
                ". Incoming invoice: " + TmpInvoiceNo + "; supplier code: " + TmpSysAcCode.ToString() +
                ". No existing purchase was overwritten.")
        End If
        PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = "DUPLICATE"
        PurchaseIMEILastGroupError = "Database match: company " + TmpSysCompCode.ToString() +
            ", " + TmpSeries + " " + TmpTrnNo + ", invoice " + Convert.ToString(Header("InvNo")) +
            ", supplier " + Convert.ToString(Header("SysAcCode"))
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Sub GetDataPurchaseIMEI()
        Dim PurchaseRow As Integer = 1
        Dim Processed As New System.Collections.Generic.HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.Ordinal)
        PurchaseIMEIActive = True
        PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine("Purchase import results - " + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
        PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine("Input: " + TxtFilePath.Text)
        Try
            PreparePurchaseIMEIRows()
            While PurchaseRow < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
                Dim GroupStart As Integer = PurchaseRow
                Dim GroupEnd As Integer = PurchaseRow
                Dim Description As String = "Working row " + PurchaseRow.ToString()
                PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = ""
                PurchaseIMEILastGroupError = ""
                Try
                    Description = PurchaseIMEICell(GroupStart, "TrnSeries") + " " + PurchaseIMEICell(GroupStart, "TrnNo") +
                        " | Invoice " + PurchaseIMEICell(GroupStart, "InvNo") +
                        " | Company " + PurchaseIMEICell(GroupStart, "SysCompCodeALL")
                    Dim Key As String = PurchaseIMEIKey(GroupStart)
                    While GroupEnd + 1 < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
                        Dim NextKey As String
                        Try
                            NextKey = PurchaseIMEIKey(GroupEnd + 1)
                        Catch
                            Exit While
                        End Try
                        If NextKey <> Key Then Exit While
                        GroupEnd += 1
                    End While
                    If Not Processed.Add(Key) Then
                        Throw New InvalidOperationException("This GRN appeared again after grouping. Remaining rows were not saved; review the group identity.")
                    End If
                    start = GroupStart
                    k = GroupEnd
                    start1 = GroupStart
                    k1 = GroupEnd
                    end1 = GroupEnd
                    ReadPurchaseIMEIHeader(GroupStart)
                    Dim Invoice As String = TmpInvoiceNo
                    Dim Supplier As String = TmpSysAcCode.ToString()
                    Dim ImportedRows As Integer = 0
                    For Row As Integer = GroupStart To GroupEnd
                        If PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "InvNo") <> Invoice OrElse PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "SysAcCode") <> Supplier Then
                            Throw New InvalidOperationException("Different invoices/suppliers use the same company/series/GRN in the file.")
                        End If
                        If PurchaseIMEICell(Row, "Import").ToUpperInvariant() = "I" Then ImportedRows += 1
                        VsfgSelect(Row, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = Row - GroupStart + 1
                    Next
                    If ImportedRows = GroupEnd - GroupStart + 1 Then
                        'Already completed by this grid session: do not label it a database duplicate.
                        PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = "ALREADY PROCESSED"
                    ElseIf ImportedRows > 0 Then
                        Throw New InvalidOperationException("Only part of this GRN is marked imported. Review the existing purchase before retrying.")
                    ElseIf Not CheckPurchaseIMEIExisting() Then
                        MakeStringPur()
                        If PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = "" Then
                            Throw New InvalidOperationException("Purchase preparation returned without saving or recording a result.")
                        End If
                    End If
                Catch exGroup As Exception
                    PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = "FAILED"
                    PurchaseIMEILastGroupError = exGroup.Message
                    Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE FAILED: " + Description + Environment.NewLine + exGroup.ToString())
                End Try
                Select Case PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus
                    Case "SAVED"
                        PurchaseIMEISavedCount += 1
                    Case "DUPLICATE"
                        PurchaseIMEIDuplicateCount += 1
                    Case "ALREADY PROCESSED"
                        'Do not inflate either saved or duplicate counts on retry.
                    Case Else
                        PurchaseIMEIFailedCount += 1
                End Select
                PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine(Description + " | Rows " + GroupStart.ToString() + "-" + GroupEnd.ToString() +
                    " | " + PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus + " | " + PurchaseIMEILastGroupError)
                'Use local boundaries, independent of shared counters used by calculations.
                PurchaseRow = GroupEnd + 1
            End While
        Catch ex As Exception
            PurchaseIMEIFailedCount += 1
            PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine("IMPORT STOPPED; remaining rows were not attempted: " + ex.ToString())
        Finally
            PurchaseIMEIActive = False
            PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine("Saved: " + PurchaseIMEISavedCount.ToString() +
                "; existing: " + PurchaseIMEIDuplicateCount.ToString() + "; failed: " + PurchaseIMEIFailedCount.ToString())
            Try
                PurchaseIMEIReportPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "PurchaseImport-" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".txt")
                File.WriteAllText(PurchaseIMEIReportPath, PurchaseIMEIReport.ToString())
            Catch ex As Exception
                PurchaseIMEIReportPath = ""
                PurchaseIMEIReport.AppendLine("Could not write the report: " + ex.Message)
            End Try
        End Try
    End Sub


    Private Sub GetData()

        '=====================================================================
        ' IMEI PURCHASE GROUPING FIX
        '
        ' IMPORTANT:
        ' Only Purchase files containing an IMEI column use the dedicated
        ' grouping routine below.
        '
        ' All other imports continue through the ORIGINAL GetData() logic
        ' exactly as before.
        '=====================================================================
        If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 AndAlso d1 IsNot Nothing AndAlso d1.Columns.Contains("IMEI") Then
            GetDataPurchaseIMEI()
            Exit Sub
        End If

        start = 1
        Dim SeqNo As Integer = 1
        end1 = 1
        k = 1
        Try

            VsfgSelect(1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = SeqNo

            While k < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
                If VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Import")) = "I" Then
                    GoTo l_3
                End If
                If k = VsfgSelect.Rows.Count - 1 Then
                    GoTo l_2
                End If
                If VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString.Trim() = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString.Trim() Then
                    If k <> 1 Then
                        If VsfgSelect(k - 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Import")) = "I" Then
                            VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = "1"
                            start = k
                        Else
                            VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = VsfgSelect(k - 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) + 1
                        End If
                    End If
                    end1 = end1 + 1
                Else
l_2:
                    start1 = start
                    k1 = k
                    VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = 1
                    If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 0 Then
                        MakeStringSal()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 Then
                        MakeStringPur()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 2 Then
                        MakeStringCRN()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 3 Then
                        MakeStringDRN()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 4 Then
                        MakeStringStockin()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 5 Then
                        MakeStringStockOut()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 6 Then
                        MakeStringStockDamOut()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 7 Then
                        MakeStringStockGDDam()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 8 Then
                        TmpNetAmt = 0
                        MakeStringExp()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 9 Then
                        MakeStringPay()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.Text = "Set Credit Note to Bill" Then
                        SaveCreditNoteinBill()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 13 Then
                        MakeStringJOU()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 12 Then
                        MakeStringCON()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 16 Then
                        MakeStringDrnOther()
                    ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 19 Then
                        SaveEwbillno()
                    End If
                    start = k + 1 ' end1 + 1
                    '  end1 = start
                    SeqNo = 1
                End If
l_3:
                k = k + 1
l_1:
            End While
        Catch ex As Exception

        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub GetDataRec()
        start = 1
        Dim SeqNo As Integer = 1
        end1 = 1
        k = 1
        VsfgSelect(1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = SeqNo
        While k < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count
            If k = VsfgSelect.Rows.Count - 1 Then
                GoTo l_2
            End If
            If VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")).ToString = "" Then
                VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")) = "0"

                VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")) = ""

            If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex <> 10 Then

                    If k <> 1 Then
                        VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = VsfgSelect(k - 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) + 1
                    End If
                    end1 = end1 + 1
                End If
                'ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 10 And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecAmt")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecAmt")) Then 'And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ChqNo")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ChqNo"))
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 10 And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecAmt")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecAmt")) And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecNo")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecNo")) And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecSeries")).ToString = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RecSeries")).ToString And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysAcCodeDr")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysAcCodeDr")) Then

                If k <> 1 Then
                    VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = VsfgSelect(k - 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) + 1
                End If
                end1 = end1 + 1
            Else
l_2:
                start1 = start
                k1 = k
                VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = 1
                If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 0 Then
                    MakeStringSal()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 Then
                    MakeStringPur()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 2 Then
                    MakeStringCRN()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 3 Then
                    MakeStringDRN()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 4 Then
                    MakeStringStockin()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 5 Then
                    MakeStringStockOut()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 6 Then
                    MakeStringStockDamOut()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 7 Then
                    MakeStringStockGDDam()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 8 Then
                    MakeStringExp()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 9 Then
                    MakeStringPay()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 10 Then
                    MakeStringREC()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.Text = "Set Credit Note to Bill" Then
                    SaveCreditNoteinBill()
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 19 Then
                    SaveEwbillno()
                End If
                start = k + 1 ' end1 + 1
                '  end1 = start
                SeqNo = 1
            End If
            k = k + 1
l_1:
        End While
    End Sub

    Private Sub GetDataScheme()
        start = 1
        Dim SeqNo As Integer = 1
        end1 = 1
        k = 1
        VsfgSelect(1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = SeqNo
        While k < VsfgSelect.Rows.Count

            If k = VsfgSelect.Rows.Count - 1 Then
                GoTo l_2
            End If
            If VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchNo")) = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchNo")) And VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchName")).ToString.Trim() = VsfgSelect(k + 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchName")).ToString.Trim() Then
                If k <> 1 Then
                    VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = VsfgSelect(k - 1, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) + 1
                End If
                end1 = end1 + 1
            Else
l_2:
                start1 = start
                k1 = k
                VsfgSelect(k, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")) = 1
                MakeStringScheme()
                start = k + 1 ' end1 + 1
                '  end1 = start
                SeqNo = 1
            End If
l_3:
            k = k + 1
l_1:
        End While
    End Sub

    Private Sub SetUnitRate()
        Dim CurrRow As Integer = 0
        CurrRow = iRow
        Dim s1 As String = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.UCase(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("UNIT")))))
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "BOX", False) = 0
        If flag1 Then
            VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BOX")))), "######0.0000")
        Else
            flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "INBOX", False) = 0
            If flag1 Then
                VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX")))), "######0.0000")
            Else
                flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "KG/LTR", False) = 0
                If flag1 Then
                    VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / (1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight"))))), "######0.0000")
                Else
                    flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "OUTER", False) = 0
                    If flag1 Then
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX")))), "######0.0000")
                    Else
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))), "######0.0000")
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End Sub


    Private Sub SetRate()
        Dim CurrRow As Integer = 0
        CurrRow = iRow
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.StrComp(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.UCase(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(InvType)), "R", Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompareMethod.Text) = 0
        If flag1 Then
            Dim d1 As Double = 0.0R
            d1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) + (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("VAT")))) / 100.0R)
            Dim s1 As String = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.UCase(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("UNIT")))))
            flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "BOX", False) = 0
            If flag1 Then
                VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(d1) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BOX")))), "######0.0000")
            Else
                flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "INBOX", False) = 0
                If flag1 Then
                    VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(d1) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX")))), "######0.0000")
                Else
                    flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "KG/LTR", False) = 0
                    If flag1 Then
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(d1) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * (1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight"))))), "#0.0000")
                    Else
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(d1) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))), "######0.0000")
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Else
            Dim s2 As String = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.UCase(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("UNIT")))))
            flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s2, "BOX", False) = 0
            If flag1 Then
                VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BOX")))), "######0.0000")
            Else
                flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s2, "INBOX", False) = 0
                If flag1 Then
                    VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX")))), "######0.0000")
                Else
                    flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s2, "KG/LTR", False) = 0
                    If flag1 Then
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))) * (1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight"))))), "#0.0000")
                    Else
                        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SRATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATEPERUNIT")))), "######0.0000")
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If


        If TmpPriDiscAmt.ToString = "Y" Then
            SqlStr = "Select DiscAmt from Mas_ShortName where SysProdCode='" + VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode")).ToString + "'"
            dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
            If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)("DiscAmt").ToString > 0 Then
                VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) = VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")) - dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)("DiscAmt").ToString
            End If
        End If

    End Sub


    Private Function SetQty(ByVal TmpOrgQTY As Single) As Single
        Dim CurrRow As Integer = 0
        CurrRow = iRow
        Dim f2 As Single
        Dim s1 As String = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.UCase(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("UNIT")))))
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "BOX", False) = 0
        If flag1 Then
            f2 = CSng(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpOrgQTY))
            f2 = CSng((CDbl(f2) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BOX"))))))
        Else
            flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "INBOX", False) = 0
            If flag1 Then
                f2 = CSng(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpOrgQTY))
                f2 = CSng((CDbl(f2) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX"))))))
            Else
                flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "KG/LTR", False) = 0
                If flag1 Then
                    f2 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToSingle(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpOrgQTY) * 1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight")))), "#0.000"))
                Else
                    flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators.CompareString(s1, "OUTER", False) = 0
                    If flag1 Then
                        f2 = CSng(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpOrgQTY))
                        f2 = CSng((CDbl(f2) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("INBOX"))))))

                    Else
                        f2 = CSng(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpOrgQTY))
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
        VsfgSelect(CurrRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQTY")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(f2), "#0.000")

        Return f2

    End Function

    '=====================================================================
    ' OPTIONAL PURCHASE IMEI / SERIAL NUMBER SAVE
    '
    ' IMPORTANT:
    '   - Runs ONLY when the imported Excel contains an IMEI column.
    '   - Blank IMEI rows are ignored.
    '   - Normal Purchase import logic is not changed.
    '   - Called only AFTER Add_Purchase succeeds.
    '=====================================================================
    Private Sub SavePurchaseIMEIIfPresent(ByVal PurchaseTrnNo As String,
                                          ByVal PurchaseTrnSeries As String,
                                          ByVal PurchaseTrnDate As String)

        Try
            '-------------------------------------------------------------
            ' OLD / NORMAL PURCHASE FILE:
            ' If IMEI column is absent, exit immediately.
            '-------------------------------------------------------------
            If d1 Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            If Not d1.Columns.Contains("IMEI") Then Exit Sub

            Dim IMEIColIndex As Integer = VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("IMEI")
            If IMEIColIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub

            Dim TmpPurchaseTrnNo As Integer = 0
            If Not Integer.TryParse(PurchaseTrnNo.Trim(), TmpPurchaseTrnNo) Then
                Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI NOT SAVED - Invalid Purchase TrnNo: " + PurchaseTrnNo)
                Exit Sub
            End If

            Dim TmpPurchaseDate As DateTime
            If Not DateTime.TryParse(PurchaseTrnDate, TmpPurchaseDate) Then
                Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI NOT SAVED - Invalid Purchase Date: " + PurchaseTrnDate)
                Exit Sub
            End If

            Dim SerialRow As Integer

            'Current Purchase being saved contains rows from start through k.
            For SerialRow = start To k

                If SerialRow <= 0 OrElse SerialRow >= VsfgSelect.Rows.Count Then
                    Continue For
                End If

                '---------------------------------------------------------
                ' Process only rows belonging to the Purchase just saved.
                '---------------------------------------------------------
                Try
                    If VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo") >= 0 Then
                        If Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(
                            VsfgSelect(SerialRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")).ToString()
                        ) <> TmpPurchaseTrnNo Then
                            Continue For
                        End If
                    End If

                    If VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries") >= 0 Then
                        If VsfgSelect(SerialRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString().Trim() <>
                           PurchaseTrnSeries.Trim() Then
                            Continue For
                        End If
                    End If
                Catch
                    'Do not stop normal Purchase import because of this check.
                End Try

                '---------------------------------------------------------
                ' Read IMEI and preserve long numeric values.
                '---------------------------------------------------------
                Dim RawIMEI As Object = VsfgSelect(SerialRow, IMEIColIndex)
                If RawIMEI Is Nothing OrElse IsDBNull(RawIMEI) Then Continue For

                Dim IMEIText As String = ""

                If IsNumeric(RawIMEI) Then
                    Try
                        IMEIText = Convert.ToDecimal(RawIMEI).ToString("0")
                    Catch
                        IMEIText = RawIMEI.ToString().Trim()
                    End Try
                Else
                    IMEIText = RawIMEI.ToString().Trim()
                End If

                If IMEIText = "" Then Continue For

                '---------------------------------------------------------
                ' Use SysProdCode already resolved by existing import logic.
                ' No new product-matching logic is introduced.
                '---------------------------------------------------------
                Dim TmpSerialSysProdCode As Integer = 0

                Try
                    TmpSerialSysProdCode =
                        CInt(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(
                            VsfgSelect(SerialRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode")).ToString()
                        ))
                Catch
                    TmpSerialSysProdCode = 0
                End Try

                If TmpSerialSysProdCode <= 0 Then
                    Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI NOT SAVED - SysProdCode missing. IMEI: " + IMEIText)
                    Continue For
                End If

                Dim TmpSerialBatch As String = "."

                Try
                    TmpSerialBatch = VsfgSelect(SerialRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Batch")).ToString().Trim()
                    If TmpSerialBatch = "" OrElse TmpSerialBatch.ToUpper() = "NULL" Then
                        TmpSerialBatch = "."
                    End If
                Catch
                    TmpSerialBatch = "."
                End Try

                Dim TmpSerialSeqNo As Integer = 1

                Try
                    TmpSerialSeqNo =
                        CInt(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(
                            VsfgSelect(SerialRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo")).ToString()
                        ))
                    If TmpSerialSeqNo <= 0 Then TmpSerialSeqNo = 1
                Catch
                    TmpSerialSeqNo = 1
                End Try

                'Also supports multiple IMEIs in one cell.
                Dim NormalizedIMEI As String = IMEIText.Replace(vbCrLf, "|")
                NormalizedIMEI = NormalizedIMEI.Replace(vbCr, "|")
                NormalizedIMEI = NormalizedIMEI.Replace(vbLf, "|")
                NormalizedIMEI = NormalizedIMEI.Replace(",", "|")
                NormalizedIMEI = NormalizedIMEI.Replace(";", "|")

                Dim IMEIList() As String = NormalizedIMEI.Split("|"c)

                For Each OneIMEI As String In IMEIList

                    Dim TmpIMEI As String = OneIMEI.Trim()
                    If TmpIMEI = "" Then Continue For

                    Dim SerialConn As System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection = Nothing

                    Try
                        SerialConn = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.OpenYearConn()

                        Dim InsertSerialSql As String =
                            "IF NOT EXISTS (" +
                            " SELECT 1 FROM T_SerialNo " +
                            " WHERE SysProdCode=@SysProdCode AND ProdSrNo=@ProdSrNo" +
                            ") " +
                            "BEGIN " +
                            " INSERT INTO T_SerialNo " +
                            " (SysProdCode,Batch,ProdSrNo,StkInTrn,StkInSeries," +
                            "  StkInTrnNo,StkInTrnDate,StkOutTrn,StkOutSeries," +
                            "  StkOutTrnNo,StkOutTrnDate,InStock,StkInSeqNo,StkOutSeqNo) " +
                            " VALUES " +
                            " (@SysProdCode,@Batch,@ProdSrNo,@StkInTrn,@StkInSeries," +
                            "  @StkInTrnNo,@StkInTrnDate,@StkOutTrn,@StkOutSeries," +
                            "  @StkOutTrnNo,@StkOutTrnDate,@InStock,@StkInSeqNo,@StkOutSeqNo) " +
                            "END"

                        Using InsertSerialCmd As New System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand(InsertSerialSql, SerialConn)
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@SysProdCode", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TmpSerialSysProdCode
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@Batch", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = TmpSerialBatch
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@ProdSrNo", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = TmpIMEI
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkInTrn", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = "PUR"
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkInSeries", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = PurchaseTrnSeries
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkInTrnNo", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TmpPurchaseTrnNo
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkInTrnDate", SqlDbType.DateTime).Value = TmpPurchaseDate
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkOutTrn", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = ""
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkOutSeries", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = ""
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkOutTrnNo", SqlDbType.Int).Value = 0
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkOutTrnDate", SqlDbType.DateTime).Value = DBNull.Value
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@InStock", SqlDbType.VarChar).Value = "Y"
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkInSeqNo", SqlDbType.Int).Value = TmpSerialSeqNo
                            InsertSerialCmd.Parameters.Add("@StkOutSeqNo", SqlDbType.Int).Value = 0
                            InsertSerialCmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                        End Using

                        Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI SAVED - SysProdCode: " +
                                        TmpSerialSysProdCode.ToString() +
                                        " | IMEI: " + TmpIMEI +
                                        " | Purchase: " + PurchaseTrnSeries + "/" +
                                        TmpPurchaseTrnNo.ToString())

                    Catch ex As Exception
                        'IMEI error must not cancel/change normal Purchase import.
                        Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI SAVE ERROR: " + ex.Message)

                    Finally
                        If SerialConn IsNot Nothing Then
                            Try
                                Ultimate.Mod_Connection.CloseYearConn(SerialConn)
                            Catch
                            End Try
                        End If
                    End Try

                Next
            Next

        Catch ex As Exception
            'Absolute isolation from normal Purchase import.
            Debug.WriteLine("PURCHASE IMEI OPTIONAL LOGIC ERROR: " + ex.Message)
        End Try

    End Sub

        strRatePerUnit = ""
        strSysCompCode = ""
        strBox = ""
        strInBox = ""
        strBoxName = ""
        strInBoxName = ""
        StrPurSysAcCode = ""
        StrVatSysAcCode = ""

        StrCGST = ""
        StrSGST = ""
        StrIGST = ""
        StrCGSTSysAcCode = ""
        StrSGSTSysAcCode = ""
        StrIGSTSysAcCode = ""

        StrCess = ""
        StrCessAmt = ""
        StrCessPerPCS = ""
        StrCessPerPCSAmt = ""

        TmpGrossAmt = 0
        TmpSurchargeAmt = 0

        TmpRndAmt = 0
        TmpVatAmt = 0
        TmpBVDisc1 = 0
        TmpBVDisc2 = 0

        TmpBVDisc4 = 0

        ItemCount = 0

        TmpCGST = 0
        TmpSGST = 0
