        TmpCess2 = 0

        '=============================================================
        ' SPECIAL SAFE HANDLING FOR PURCHASE FILES WITH IMEI
        '
        ' Normal Purchase files are NOT affected.
        '
        ' Problem fixed:
        ' If SysProdCode of the next Purchase was 0, MakeStringPur()
        ' previously reached SaveBill() with the PREVIOUS Purchase's
        ' TmpTrnNo/TmpSeries. This caused repeated messages such as
        ' "GRN 1 already exists".
        '
        ' For an IMEI file:
        '   1) Load the CURRENT GRN header before product processing.
        '   2) Validate every row in the current GRN.
        '   3) If any product is not mapped, skip only that GRN and
        '      show the actual GRN/product instead of reusing old data.
        '=============================================================
        If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 AndAlso d1.Columns.Contains("IMEI") Then

            Try
                TmpSeries = VsfgSelect(start, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString().Trim()
                TmpTrnNo = VsfgSelect(start, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")).ToString().Trim()
                TmpTrnDate = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(
                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDate(
                        VsfgSelect(start, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnDate"))
                    ),
                    "dd/MM/yyyy"
                )

                If VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InvNo") >= 0 Then
                    TmpInvoiceNo = VsfgSelect(start, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InvNo")).ToString().Trim()
                End If

                If VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InvDate") >= 0 Then
                    TmpInvoiceDate = VsfgSelect(start, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InvDate")).ToString().Trim()
                    If TmpInvoiceDate = "" OrElse TmpInvoiceDate = "0" Then
                        TmpInvoiceDate = TmpTrnDate
                    End If
                End If
            Catch ex As Exception
                'Do not continue with a previous purchase's header.
                Throw New InvalidOperationException("Cannot read the current purchase header: " + ex.Message, ex)
            End Try

            Dim TmpValidateRow As Integer = start

            While TmpValidateRow <= k

                Dim TmpValidateSysProdCode As Integer = 0

                Try
                    TmpValidateSysProdCode = CInt(
                        Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(
                            VsfgSelect(
                                TmpValidateRow,
                                VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode")
                            ).ToString()
                        )
                    )
                Catch
                    TmpValidateSysProdCode = 0
                End Try

                If TmpValidateSysProdCode <= 0 Then

                    Dim TmpMissingProdCode As String = ""
                    Dim TmpMissingProdName As String = ""

                    Try
                        TmpMissingProdCode =
                            VsfgSelect(
                                TmpValidateRow,
                                VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode")
                            ).ToString().Trim()
                    Catch
                    End Try

                    Try
                        TmpMissingProdName =
                            VsfgSelect(
                                TmpValidateRow,
                                VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ProdName")
                            ).ToString().Trim()
                    Catch
                    End Try

                    PurchaseIMEILastGroupStatus = "FAILED"
                    PurchaseIMEILastGroupError =
                        "Purchase " + TmpSeries + " " + TmpTrnNo +
                        " - product not mapped: " +
                        TmpMissingProdCode + " " + TmpMissingProdName

                    MessageBox.Show(
                        "Purchase " + TmpSeries + " " + TmpTrnNo +
                        " was not imported because a product is not mapped." +
                        Environment.NewLine +
                        "Product Code: " + TmpMissingProdCode +
                        Environment.NewLine +
                        "Product Name: " + TmpMissingProdName +
                        Environment.NewLine +
                        "Map/Create this product and import the file again.",
                        Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName,
                        MessageBoxButtons.OK,
                        MessageBoxIcon.Information
                    )

                    Exit Sub

                End If

                TmpValidateRow = TmpValidateRow + 1
            End While

        End If

        iRow = start
        While flag1
            flag1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode")))) > 0.0R
            If flag1 Then
                strSeqNo = strSeqNo + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SeqNo"))))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                'SqlStr = "Select cd.* from T_CommonProduct cd,Mas_Product p"
                'SqlStr = SqlStr + " where cd.SysProdCode=p.SysProdCode and cd.CompProdCode='" + VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ProdCode")).ToString + "' and p.SysCompCode='" + TmpSysCompCode.ToString + "'"
                'dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
                'If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
                '    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode")) = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)("SysProdCode").ToString
                'End If
                strSysProdCode = strSysProdCode + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysProdCode"))))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                strProdCode = strProdCode + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("PRODCODE")))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                strProdName = strProdName + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("PRODNAME")))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(40), 1, 40)
                If VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Batch")).ToString <> "" Or VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Batch")).ToString <> "NULL" Then
                    strBatch = strBatch + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BATCH")).ToString)) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                Else
                    strBatch = strBatch + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString("")) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                End If
                strMRP = strMRP + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("MRP")))), "Fixed") + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                flag1 = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("EXPDT")).ToString() <> "0"
                If flag1 Then
                    strExpDt = strExpDt + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDate(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("EXPDT"))), "yyyy/MM/dd") + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)

                strUnit = strUnit + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("UNIT")))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                strQty = strQty + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("QTY")))), "###0.000") + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)
                If d1.Columns.Contains("FrQty") Then
                    strFrQty = strFrQty + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("FrQty"))))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)

                End If
                If VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Unit")).ToString.Trim = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("DefaultUnit")).ToString Then
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQty")) = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Qty"))
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE"))
                ElseIf VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Unit")).ToString.Trim = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BoxName")).ToString() Then
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQty")) = CSng((CDbl(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Qty"))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BOX"))))))
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Box")))), "######0.0000")
                ElseIf VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Unit")).ToString.Trim = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxName")).ToString() Then
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQty")) = CSng((CDbl(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Qty"))) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InBOX"))))))
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("InBox")))), "######0.0000")
                ElseIf VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Unit")).ToString.Trim = "Kg" Then
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQty")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToSingle(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Qty"))) * 1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight")))), "#0.000"))
                    VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORATE")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("RATE")))) / (1000.0R / Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Weight"))))), "######0.0000")

                CalculateVat(iRow)
                VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("AMOUNT")) = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("OQty")) * VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ORate"))
                VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Taxable")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("AMOUNT")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC1")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC2")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC3")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC4")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC5")) - VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVDISC6")))), "###0.00")


                VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("BVAdd1")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Taxable")).ToString()) * Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("APMC")).ToString()) / 100, "#0.00")
                CalculateVat(iRow)

    Private Sub MakeStringScheme()
        Dim flag1 As Boolean
        Dim i8 As Integer = 1
        Dim m As Integer
        flag1 = True
        SlabCnt = 0
        MutiProdCnt = 0
        StrSlabSNO = ""
        StrSlabSCHON = ""
        StrSlabFQTY = ""
        StrSlabDISCPER = ""
        StrSlabDISCAMT = ""
        StrSlabAMTPER = ""
        StrSlabFRPRODID = ""
        StrMutiProdCode = ""
        MultiProdCnt = 0
        StrMultiSlabNo = ""
        StrMultiSlabFrProdId = ""
        MultiSlabCnt = 0
        MutiProdCnt = 0
        StrMutiProdCode = ""
        iRow = start
        flag1 = True
        '   Dim i1 As Integer = VsfgSlabs.Rows.Count - 1
        m = 1
        While flag1
            If VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchBase")) = "MULTIPLE PRODUCT LEVEL" Then
                Dim StrFrSysProdCode As String = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SchemeONFreeSysProdCode")).ToString()
                Dim StrFSysProdcode As String = ""

                If StrFrSysProdCode.Length > 0 Then
                    While StrFrSysProdCode.Length > 0
                        If StrFrSysProdCode.Contains(" ") Then
                            StrFSysProdcode = StrFrSysProdCode.Substring(0, StrFrSysProdCode.IndexOf(" ") - 1)
                        Else
                            StrFSysProdcode = StrFrSysProdCode
                        End If

                        If flag1 Then
                            SlabCnt = SlabCnt + 1
                            StrSlabSNO = StrSlabSNO + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Mid(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(VsfgSelect.GetData(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SlabNo")))))) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Space(20), 1, 20)

        TmpNarr = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Narr")).ToString
        TmpNetAmt = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Amt")).ToString
        TmpSysAcCodeDr = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysAcCodeDr")).ToString
        TmpSysAcCodeCr = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysAcCodeCr")).ToString
        TmpchqNo = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("ChqNo")).ToString

        End If

        If TmpchqNo.ToString = "0" Then

        End If


        SaveBill()
    End Sub

    Private Sub MakeCalculation()
        UltimateToUltimate = ""
        If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex <> 10 Then
            TmpSeries = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnSeries")).ToString.Trim()
            If (TmpSeries.Length <= 4 And CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 2) Then
                If VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysCompCode")) > 0 Then
                    TmpSeries = TmpSeries + VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("SysCompCode")).ToString
                End If
            End If
            TmpTrnNo = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnNo")).ToString.Trim()

            If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 13 Then
                TmpTrnDate = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDate(VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("TrnDate"))), "dd/MM/yyyy")
                TmpNarr = VsfgSelect(iRow, VsfgSelect.Cols.IndexOf("Narr")).ToString
                GoTo l1
            End If

            ' Purchase import must keep the GRN/TrnNo coming from Excel.
            ' The old auto-voucher block reads the next number from T_SAL_Header,
            ' which can overwrite every purchase GRN with 1 and cause false duplicates.
            ' Exclude Purchase only; all other existing auto-voucher behavior stays unchanged.
            If TmpAutoVoucher = "Y" AndAlso CmbEntry.SelectedIndex <> 1 Then
                SqlStr = "  SELECT ISNULL(MAX(TrnNo),0)+1 FROM T_SAL_Header WHERE TrnSeries='" + TmpSeries.ToString + "'"
                dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
                If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
                    TmpTrnNo = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString
                End If
            End If

                Else
                    flag2 = ChngCd = 3
                    If flag2 Then
                        d1 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpGrossAmt) - (Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpTprAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpSchAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpBtmAmt) + Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(TmpStarAmt))

    Private Sub OpenFileDialogBox_FileOk(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs) Handles OpenFileDialogBox.FileOk
        StrFileName = OpenFileDialogBox.FileName.ToString()
        TxtFilePath.Text = StrFileName
        If CmbBankAcc.Visible = False Then
            BtnGo.Focus()
        Else
            CmbBankAcc.Focus()
        End If

    End Sub

    Private Sub VsfgSelect_LostFocus(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles VsfgSelect.LostFocus
        VsfgSelect.Visible = False
    End Sub

    Private Sub CmbEntry_LostFocus(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles CmbEntry.LostFocus
        Try


            '----For Excel Selection 
            Dim TmpFile As String = ""

            SqlStr = "Select ExcelName From T_ImportExcelLocking Where"
            If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 0 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='SAL' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 1 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='PUR' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 2 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='CRN' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 3 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='DRN' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 4 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='STKIN' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 5 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='STKOUT' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 14 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='SetCr' "
            ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 19 Then
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " Type='EinvoiceImport' "
            End If

            If CmbComp.Text = "All" Then
            Else
                SqlStr = SqlStr + " and SysCompCode='" + CmbComp.SelectedValue.ToString + "'"
            End If
            dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)
            If dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows.Count > 0 Then
                TmpFile = dsfrm.Tables(0).Rows(0)(0).ToString

                If File.Exists(TmpFile.ToString) Then
                    TxtFilePath.Text = TmpFile
                    BtnGo.Focus()
                Else
                    BtnSave1.Focus()
                End If
            End If
        Catch ex As Exception

        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub SetTxtFontColor()
        Dim rectangle1 As System.Drawing.Rectangle = VsfgProduct.GetCellRect(VsfgProduct.Row, VsfgProduct.Col)
        txtEdit.Left = rectangle1.Left + 37 ' 18
        txtEdit.Top = rectangle1.Top + 160 '170 '145
        txtEdit.BringToFront()
        txtEdit.Height = rectangle1.Height
        txtEdit.Width = rectangle1.Width
        txtEdit.Font = VsfgProduct.Font
        txtEdit.BackColor = VsfgProduct.BackColor
        txtEdit.ForeColor = VsfgProduct.ForeColor
        txtEdit.TextAlign = System.Windows.Forms.HorizontalAlignment.Left
        txtEdit.Visible = True
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Company") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Weight") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("HSNCode") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BasicUnit") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTNo") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Area") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CompAcCode") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CompAcName") = VsfgProduct.Col)
        If flag1 Then
            txtEdit.Text = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToString(VsfgProduct.GetData(VsfgProduct.Row, VsfgProduct.Col)))
        Else
            flag1 = (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add1") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add2") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Town") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Pin") = VsfgProduct.Col) Or (VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("State") = VsfgProduct.Col)

            End If

            End If
        End If

        txtEdit.SelectionStart = 0
        txtEdit.SelectionLength = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Len(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Trim(txtEdit.Text))
        txtEdit.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub VsfgProduct_KeyDown(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.Windows.Forms.KeyEventArgs) Handles VsfgProduct.KeyDown

        CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Col
        CurrRow = VsfgProduct.Row
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = e.KeyCode = System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Enter
        If flag1 Then

            Dim i1 As Integer = VsfgProduct.Col

            If (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Company")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Weight")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("HSNCode")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BasicUnit")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS")) Then
                SetTxtFontColor()
            ElseIf (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add1")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add2")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Town")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Pin")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("State")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTNo")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Area")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CompAcCode")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CompAcName")) Then
                SetTxtFontColor()
            ElseIf (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTType")) OrElse (i1 = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SetArea")) Then
                SetCmbFontColor()

            End If

        End If

    End Sub

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0")

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()



            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack") Then
                flag4 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToInteger(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0")) < 0.0R

                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("InBoxpack should not be Negative!", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, "Import Data")
                    VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")
                    VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                    GoTo label_0
                End If

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0")

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer")

                VsfgSelection.Top = VsfgProduct.Top + 150

                VsfgSelection.Height = 350


                SqlStr = "select SysVatCode,VatPer,PurVatType,SalVatType,VatType from mas_vat order by VatPer"
                dsfrm = Ultimate.Mod_Connection.ReturnYeardata(SqlStr)

                c1FlexGrid3.AllowResizing = CType(1, C1.Win.C1FlexGrid.AllowResizingEnum)
                c1FlexGrid3.AutoSearch = CType(2, C1.Win.C1FlexGrid.AutoSearchEnum)
                c1FlexGrid3.AllowAddNew = False
                c1FlexGrid3.AllowEditing = False
                c1FlexGrid3.AutoResize = False
                c1FlexGrid3.AutoSize = False
                c1FlexGrid3.ExtendLastCol = False

                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("SysVatCode")).Caption = "SysVatCode"
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("VatPer")).Caption = "GST%"
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("PurVatType")).Caption = "PurVatType"
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("SalVatType")).Caption = "SalVatType"


                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("SysVatCode")).Width = 0
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("VatPer")).Width = 80
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("PurVatType")).Width = 220
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("SalVatType")).Width = 220
                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("VatType")).Width = 0

                c1FlexGrid3.GetCellStyleDisplay(0, 1).ForeColor = System.Drawing.Color.Red
                c1FlexGrid3.Focus()
                c1FlexGrid3 = Nothing
                If dt.Rows.Count = 0 Then
                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("First Vat/GST Master.", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.UseedFormName)
                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                    GoTo label_0
                Else

                    VsfgSelection.Visible = True
                    VsfgSelection.Select(1, 1)
                    VsfgSelection.Focus()
                End If


            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("HSNCode") Then


                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("HSNCode")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BasicUnit")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BasicUnit") Then


                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BasicUnit")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess") Then
                flag4 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0.00")) < 0.0R

                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Cess% should not be Negative!", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, "Import Data")
                    VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess")

                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                    GoTo label_0

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Cess")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0.00")

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()


            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS") Then
                flag4 = Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Conversions.ToDouble(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0.00")) < 0.0R

                    Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction.MsgBox("Cess/PCS should not be Negative!", Microsoft.VisualBasic.MsgBoxStyle.Information, "Import Data")
                    VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS")
                    VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                    GoTo label_0
                End If

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CessPerPCS")) = Microsoft.VisualBasic.Strings.Format(Microsoft.VisualBasic.Conversion.Val(txtEdit.Text), "#0.00")

                If VsfgProduct.Rows.Count - 1 > CurrRow Then
                    VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName")
                    VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow + 1
                    VsfgProduct.Focus()
                Else
                    BtnSave.Focus()
                End If


            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add1") Then


                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add1")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add2")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add2") Then

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Add2")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Town")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTNo") Then

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTNo")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTType")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Town") Then

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Town")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Pin")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow
                VsfgProduct.Focus()

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Pin") Then

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Pin")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("State")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("State")) = txtEdit.Text

                VsfgProduct.Col = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTNo")
                VsfgProduct.Row = CurrRow

                VsfgSelection.Top = VsfgProduct.Top + 150
                VsfgSelection.Width = 300
                VsfgSelection.Height = 350

                c1FlexGrid3.AllowSorting = CType(1, C1.Win.C1FlexGrid.AllowSortingEnum)

                c1FlexGrid3.AllowEditing = False
                c1FlexGrid3.AutoResize = False
                c1FlexGrid3.AutoSize = False

                c1FlexGrid3.Cols(c1FlexGrid3.Cols.IndexOf("AreaName")).Width = 200

    Private Sub txtEdit_KeyPress(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.Windows.Forms.KeyPressEventArgs) Handles txtEdit.KeyPress
        If CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Weight") Then
            Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.CheckDecimal(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), e, 14, 3)
        ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BoxPack") Then
            Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.CheckInteger(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), e, 10)
        ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("InBoxPack") Then
            Ultimate.Mod_GlobFunction.CheckInteger(System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(sender), e, 10)

        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub txtEdit_LostFocus(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles txtEdit.LostFocus
        txtEdit.Text = ""
        txtEdit.Visible = False
    End Sub

    Private Sub VsfgSelection_KeyDown(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.Windows.Forms.KeyEventArgs) Handles VsfgSelection.KeyDown
        Dim flag1 As Boolean = e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter
        If flag1 Then

            If CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Company") Then
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Company")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("CompName")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SysCompCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SysCompCode")).ToString

                If CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 17 Then
                    VsfgProduct.Select(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName"))
                ElseIf CmbEntry.SelectedIndex = 18 Then
                    VsfgProduct.Select(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Area"))
                End If

                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                VsfgSelection.Visible = False

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName") Then

                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrandName")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrName")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SubBrCode")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("BrCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("BrCode")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubGrpCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SubGrpCode")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GrpCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("GrpCode")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SubCatCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SubCatCode")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CatCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("CatCode")).ToString

                VsfgProduct.Select(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Weight"))
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                VsfgSelection.Visible = False

            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer") Then
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("GSTPer")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("VatPer")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("SysVatCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("SysVatCode")).ToString

                VsfgProduct.Select(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("HSNCode"))
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                VsfgSelection.Visible = False


            ElseIf CurrCol = VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Area") Then
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("Area")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("AreaName")).ToString
                VsfgProduct(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("AreaCode")) = VsfgSelection(VsfgSelection.Row, VsfgSelection.Cols.IndexOf("AreaCode")).ToString

                VsfgProduct.Select(CurrRow, VsfgProduct.Cols.IndexOf("CompAcCode"))
                VsfgProduct.Focus()
                VsfgSelection.Visible = False

            End If
        End If


    End Sub

        VsfgSelection.Visible = False
